import sys

INF = 10**30

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    W = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+W]))

    exits = [i for i, x in enumerate(a) if x == 0]

    # If there is no exit, nobody can escape.
    if not exits:
        print(0)
        return

    # For each cell i, compute the latest time T[i] such that a person may be in i at time t
    # only for t < T[i]. For normal/exit cells T[i] = INF.
    # For fire cell with value -k, it becomes blocked at time k, so usable only for t < k.
    T = [INF] * W
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        if x < 0:
            T[i] = -x

    # Distance to nearest exit, but only through cells that can ever be entered (T >= needed time).
    # Since movement cost on line is uniform, nearest exit on left/right is enough.
    left_exit = [-1] * W
    last = -1
    for i in range(W):
        if a[i] == 0:
            last = i
        left_exit[i] = last

    right_exit = [-1] * W
    last = -1
    for i in range(W - 1, -1, -1):
        if a[i] == 0:
            last = i
        right_exit[i] = last

    ans = 0

    for s, x in enumerate(a):
        if x <= 0:
            continue  # no people generated here

        best = INF

        # Try nearest exit on the left
        e = left_exit[s]
        if e != -1:
            ok = True
            # Need to be at position j after (s-j) moves, so require s-j < T[j]
            for j in range(e, s + 1):
                if s - j >= T[j]:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                best = min(best, s - e)

        # Try nearest exit on the right
        e = right_exit[s]
        if e != -1:
            ok = True
            # Need to be at position j after (j-s) moves, so require j-s < T[j]
            for j in range(s, e + 1):
                if j - s >= T[j]:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                best = min(best, e - s)

        if best == INF:
            continue

        # A person born at time t starts moving at time t+1, so reaches exit at time t+1+best.
        # Need all traversed cells to be usable at intermediate times; the path check above
        # already guarantees feasibility for a start at movement-time 0, hence for birth time t
        # we additionally need t+best < min_j(T[j]-dist_from_s_to_j) along chosen best path.
        #
        # Instead of recomputing margins, note that for a fixed path, feasibility for birth time t
        # means for every visited cell j:
        #   t + dist(s,j) < T[j]
        # => t < T[j] - dist(s,j)
        # Count births t in [0, x-1] satisfying this.
        limit = INF

        # Evaluate left path if it attains best
        e = left_exit[s]
        if e != -1 and s - e == best:
            cur = INF
            ok = True
            for j in range(e, s + 1):
                val = T[j] - (s - j)
                if val <= 0:
                    ok = False
                    break
                if val < cur:
                    cur = val
            if ok:
                limit = min(limit, cur)

        # Evaluate right path if it attains best
        e = right_exit[s]
        if e != -1 and e - s == best:
            cur = INF
            ok = True
            for j in range(s, e + 1):
                val = T[j] - (j - s)
                if val <= 0:
                    ok = False
                    break
                if val < cur:
                    cur = val
            if ok:
                limit = min(limit, cur)

        # Need t < limit, and 0 <= t <= x-1
        ans += min(x, limit)

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
